metadata.title: Euler characteristic and flat cohomology of convex projective $4$-manifolds
metadata.abstract: Let $M=\Omega/\Gamma$ be a closed properly convex real projective $4$-manifold. We prove the Chern-Hopf-Thurston conjecture for this class of manifolds, i.e. $\chi(M)\geq0$. The argument transfers Akagawa's double-form identity on the Cheng--Yau cone over $\Omega$ to a Bochner identity on $M$, from which we deduce that $H^q(M;\Lambda^pE^*)=0$ whenever $q<p(n+1-p)/(n+1)$, in arbitrary dimension $n$, for some flat bundle $E$ naturally attached to $M$. In dimension four, this implies that the cohomology with coefficients in $\Lambda^2E^*$ concentrates in degree two.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Euler 特征符号与消失定理
analysis.workSummary: 对闭 properly convex 实射影四维流形证明 χ≥0；定向时精确得到 10χ(M)=dim H²(M;Λ²E*)，并由任意维 Bochner 恒等式给出平坦丛消失范围。
techniques: Bochner 估计与平坦丛 Euler 特征
analysis.breakthrough: 在该类四维流形中得到 χ(M)≥0；关键是将锥上的恒等式转移到流形，使 Λ²E* 系数上同调集中于二次。
analysis.limitations: 不要求严格凸、边界正则或不可约性。四维结论不直接扩展到所有闭非球面流形；更高偶数维的消失范围可能留下非中间次数，不能据此宣称所有维数符号猜想均解决。尚未逐步核验双形式恒等式。 已补读 Theorems A/B、Euler 特征与平坦丛推导，不是对整篇证明的独立核验。
